newsitem.title: USA: Limited Inc Q4 sales, net, share rise.
newsitem.headline: Limited Inc Q4 sales, net, share rise.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full year 1996 included a $0.42 per share gain from the successful public offering of about 16 percent of Abercrombie & Fitch.

1996 Q4 and full year results include impact of a special and nonrecurring $12 million pretax charge for prospective sale of Penhaligon's, a wholly owned UK- based subsidiary with 1996 sales of $5.5 million. The company has signed a letter of agreement and intends to negotiate definitive documentation and close the transaction in the near future.
1995 Pro Forma results reflect adjustments for the following:
1) 1995 general, administrative and operating expenses adjusted for Q4 1995 sale of a 60% interest in WFNNB, as if the sale occurred at beginning of 1995.
2) 1995 adjusted to reflect minority interest arising from the IBI transaction as if it occured at the beginning of 1995;
3) Weighted average shares outstanding reduced to reflect the March, 1996, 85 million share repurchase as if it had occurred at the beginning of 1995.
